translations./garage/heading: A Shelf Blocks the Old Route
translations./garage/brief: The map is back online, and the built-in A* planner can search for a new global route. Choose the tires, sensors, and computer that will execute it.
translations./prediction/heading: What Should RO-1 Do When the Old Route Is Blocked?
translations./prediction/hint: A* searches the map’s drivable space for a route from start to goal.
translations./prediction/choices/0/feedback: The controller can execute only feasible motion. A fixed obstacle needs a global route around it.
translations./prediction/choices/1/feedback: Record your prediction. Press Tab during the run to see the new route bend around the blocked area.
translations./prediction/choices/2/feedback: Seeing an obstacle does not create a detour by itself. The map and planner determine where RO-1 can go.
translations./running/heading: Reach the Supply Station by a New Route
translations./running/normal_line: RO-1: Global path ready. I’m routing around the blocked corridor.
translations./running/detected_line: RO-1: Environment sensing online. Continuing along the new path.
translations./debrief/success_summary: The map, A* path, and motion controller worked together to complete the detour.
translations./debrief/failure_summary: Open the AI view, compare the planned route with the actual path, then adjust the build.
translations./debrief/evidence_caption: The embedded A* planner generated these path nodes from the current map.
translations./debrief/failure_titles/timeout: Mission failed: supply station not reached
